rv.q: What 'Campaigns, Inc.' could use is a tighter focus on its central characters' mercenary motivations.
CAMPAIGNS, INC is brilliantly written (Will Allan), masterfully directed (Nick Bowling), and splendidly acted by the entire cast.
One cannot imagine a more perfectly-cast production.
In this author's opinion, director Nick Bowling could not have gathered a finer cast to bring this story to life. From the ensemble to the leads, not a note is out of place.
It's a spot-on, if somewhat on-the-nose historical tale of a lesser-known but prophetic event.
Allan's story is interesting yet perplexing.
